prompt: How many participants signed up across my modules last week?
final_answer:
I don't have access to your specific modules or participant data, so I can't directly tell you the number of sign-ups from last week.  

To find this information, check the reporting or dashboard section of the platform you're using (e.g., an LMS like Canvas, Moodle, or a custom system). Look for a filter that shows sign-ups by date range—set it to last week (e.g., Monday–Sunday) and sum the totals across all your modules.

If you can provide the module names or share a screenshot (without sensitive info), I can help you interpret the numbers or guide you through the steps.
